Services.Title: Custom Decks
Services.Summary: Wood and composite decks designed around how you live outside: multi-level, covered, with built-in seating, lighting and railings that last.
Highlights: New decks, designed to fit your yard

Page.Heading: Custom decks, designed and built to last
Page.Intro: A good deck becomes the room you use most all summer. We design and build decks that fit your house, your yard and the way your family spends time outside.

Sections.Title: Decks designed around your home
Sections.Text:
Every deck starts with a visit. We look at how your house sits on the lot, where the sun falls, how you get from the kitchen to the yard and what you want to do out there: grill, eat, relax or watch the kids play.

From there we sketch a plan that can include more than one level, a covered area, built-in benches or planters, and stairs placed where they make sense.

Sections.Title: Wood or composite: the right material for you
Sections.Text:
Pressure-treated wood costs less up front and looks great with regular care. Composite decking costs more but needs almost no upkeep: no staining, no splinters and no rot.

We walk you through both, with real samples and a written price for each, so you can choose with all the facts.

Sections.Title: Built right from the footings up
Sections.Text:
What you see is the boards and railings, but a deck lasts because of what is underneath: proper footings, correct joist spacing, flashing where the deck meets the house and hardware rated for outdoor use.

We pull the permits, build to code and pass the inspections, so your deck is safe for years.

Gallery.Label: Wood deck
Gallery.Alt: Large wooden deck and stone patio

Faqs.Question: How long does it take to build a deck?
Faqs.Answer: Most decks take one to three weeks of work once the permit is approved, depending on the size, the design and the weather. Your written quote includes a timeline.

Faqs.Question: Do I need a permit for a new deck?
Faqs.Answer: Most decks need a permit, especially decks attached to the house or raised off the ground. We handle the permit and the inspections for you.

Faqs.Question: Can you repair or resurface my old deck?
Faqs.Answer: Often, yes. If the frame underneath is still sound, new boards and railings can make an old deck look and feel new for much less than a full rebuild. We check the structure first and tell you honestly which option makes sense.

Faqs.Question: Is composite decking worth the extra cost?
Faqs.Answer: If you want a deck you never have to stain or seal, usually yes. If budget comes first, a well-built pressure-treated deck is a great choice. We price both so you can compare.

Page.SeoDescription: Custom wood and composite decks designed and built to last, with permits, railings, stairs and lighting. Deck repair and resurfacing too. Free estimates.

Services.Title: Home Remodeling
Services.Summary: Kitchens, bathrooms, basements and whole-room makeovers, managed start to finish by one crew that cares about the details.

Page.Heading: Home remodeling, start to finish, by one crew
Page.Intro: Whether it is one room or the whole house, we plan the work, handle the trades and keep you updated, so your remodel stays on track and on budget.

Sections.Title: One team for the whole project
Sections.Text:
A remodel can involve framing, electrical, plumbing, drywall, flooring and finish carpentry. Instead of you calling five companies, we manage it all and coordinate every trade.

The people who quote your project are the people who build it, so nothing gets lost between the estimate and the finished room.

Sections.Title: Remodels we do most
Sections.Text:
Kitchens and bathrooms are our most requested projects, followed by basements, living rooms and opening up walls for a more open floor plan.

We also update flooring, trim, doors and paint throughout the house when you want the whole home to feel new.

Sections.Title: Clear prices and no surprises
Sections.Text: You get a written, line-by-line quote before work starts. If we find something hidden behind a wall, such as old wiring or water damage, we stop, show you, and agree on the fix before we go on.

Faqs.Question: Where do I start with a remodel?
Faqs.Answer: Start with a free consultation. We look at the space, listen to what you want and give you a written plan and price. You decide from there, with no pressure.

Faqs.Question: Can we stay in the house during the remodel?
Faqs.Answer: Usually, yes. We seal off the work area, keep dust down and clean up every day. For a kitchen remodel, we help you plan a temporary kitchen area.

Faqs.Question: Do you handle the permits?
Faqs.Answer: Yes. We pull the permits the work needs and schedule the inspections.

Page.SeoDescription: Kitchen, bathroom, basement and whole-home remodeling managed start to finish by one local crew. Clear written quotes and free estimates.

Services.Title: Kitchen Remodeling
Services.Summary: New cabinets, countertops, flooring and layouts that make your kitchen easier to cook in and better to gather in.

Page.Heading: Kitchen remodeling that fits how you cook and live
Page.Intro: From a fresh update to a complete new layout, we remodel kitchens that work better every day and look great for years.

Sections.Title: Plan the kitchen you actually want
Sections.Text:
We start by learning how you use your kitchen: who cooks, where things pile up and what frustrates you today. Then we plan the layout, storage, lighting and work space around that.

If an island, a wider walkway or a wall removed would make the room work better, we tell you what it takes and what it costs.

Sections.Title: Cabinets, counters and finishes
Sections.Text:
We install cabinets, countertops, backsplashes, flooring and lighting, and help you choose materials that fit your style and budget.

You see samples and a written price for each choice before anything is ordered.

Sections.Title: A remodel that respects your home
Sections.Text: Losing your kitchen for a while is hard. We give you a clear schedule, keep the work area sealed and clean, and keep you updated so you always know what happens next.

Faqs.Question: How long does a kitchen remodel take?
Faqs.Answer: A cosmetic update can take one to two weeks. A full remodel with new cabinets and layout changes often takes several weeks, plus the time to order cabinets and counters. Your quote includes a schedule.

Faqs.Question: Can you keep my layout and just update the look?
Faqs.Answer: Yes. Keeping plumbing and appliances where they are is often the best value. New cabinet doors or cabinets, counters, backsplash and lighting can transform a kitchen.

Faqs.Question: Do you remove walls to open up a kitchen?
Faqs.Answer: Yes. We check whether the wall is load-bearing and what runs through it, then give you a plan and price to open it up safely, with permits.

Page.SeoDescription: Kitchen remodeling from simple updates to full new layouts: cabinets, countertops, islands, tile, flooring and lighting. Free written estimates.

Services.Title: Bathroom Remodeling
Services.Summary: Walk-in showers, new tubs, vanities and tile, built to keep water where it belongs and look great for years.

Page.Heading: Bathroom remodeling done right, behind the tile too
Page.Intro: A bathroom has to handle water every day. We build bathrooms that look beautiful and are sealed, ventilated and waterproofed the right way.

Sections.Title: From quick refresh to full remodel
Sections.Text:
Some bathrooms need a new vanity, lighting and paint. Others need everything taken out to the studs. We help you decide what your bathroom really needs and what it costs.

Popular projects include turning a tub into a walk-in shower, adding a double vanity and new tile floors.

Sections.Title: Waterproofing you never see, but always need
Sections.Text: Most bathroom problems start behind the walls: leaks, mold and rotted subfloors. We use proper waterproofing behind showers, slope shower floors correctly and vent moisture outside, so your new bathroom stays healthy.

Sections.Title: Safer and easier to use
Sections.Text: We can add grab bars, low-threshold or curbless showers, comfort-height toilets and better lighting, so the bathroom works for everyone in the house now and later.

Faqs.Question: How long does a bathroom remodel take?
Faqs.Answer: A typical full bathroom remodel takes about two to four weeks, depending on the size, tile work and how long fixtures take to arrive. You get a schedule with your quote.

Faqs.Question: Can you replace my tub with a walk-in shower?
Faqs.Answer: Yes. It is one of our most requested projects. We remove the tub, waterproof the area and build a tiled or panel shower that fits the space.

Faqs.Question: Will I have a working bathroom during the remodel?
Faqs.Answer: If it is your only bathroom, tell us. We plan the work to keep the time without a toilet or shower as short as possible.

Page.SeoDescription: Bathroom remodels done right: walk-in showers, tub replacement, vanities, tile and proper waterproofing. Accessible upgrades too. Free estimates.
